title: The Only Thing It Cannot Beat Is A Copy Of Itself
summary: Inject mutants into a settled population and watch one straight line decide their fate: its left end asks whether a rare newcomer can get in, its right end whether it could finish the job.

sources.title: Maynard Smith and Price, The logic of animal conflict, Nature 246 (1973) 15-18
Maynard Smith, Evolution and the Theory of Games, Cambridge University Press 1982
Hofbauer and Sigmund, Evolutionary Games and Population Dynamics, Cambridge University Press 1998
